array.string: set -l keys CRS_AIHEZU_OAI_KEY CRS_DOUBAN_OAI_KEY ONEAPI_DOUBAN_API_KEY NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS; if test -f ~/.codex/config.toml; set -l active_key (awk -F'"' '/^[[:space:]]*env_key[[:space:]]*=/ {v=$2} END {print v}' ~/.codex/config.toml); if test -n "$active_key"; set -a keys $active_key; end; end; for key in (printf '%s ' $keys | sort -u); if set -q $key; /bin/launchctl setenv $key $$key; end; end; for key in AIHEZU_OAI_KEY CRS_OAI_KEY DOUBAN_OAI_KEY; /bin/launchctl unsetenv $key >/dev/null 2>&1; end
